doc:
CONTRACT A14 constants for the SLA-transfer secondary analysis, from TRAIN records only.

Written before any test record is scored. Inputs: default@defaults on every TRAIN cell at load
level L2, CRN replicates k = 0..7 (the training references already in the campaign cache;
analysis/train_default_L2.jsonl, 160 records, all cache hits), and their per-request rows.

Per family f (train families mooncake, synthetic_sessions, agentx; the test-only families
fast25_conversation and fast25_synthetic inherit mooncake's constants, as their SLA does,
facts/calibration.json sla.<family>.inherited_from):

- (4) length-scaled TTFT, LR-08 form T_f(L) = b_f + a_f * L, with
  b_f = median TTFT (ms) of default@defaults' completed requests on f's TRAIN L2 cells, and
  a_f = 3 x the AIS uncontended per-token prefill time, taken token-weighted over the same
  requests: sum E0_prefill(ISL) / sum ISL (E0_prefill = learned_routing.e0 chunked no-reuse
  prefill, the A2 E0's prefill part).  Good iff completed, TTFT <= T_f(ISL) and mean ITL <= I.
- (5) absolute E2E: E_f = p90 e2e latency (ms, linear interpolation) of the same requests.
  Good iff completed, e2e <= E_f and mean ITL <= I.
- (2) ITL-only: completed and mean ITL <= I.  (3) E2E-slowdown-only: completed and
  e2e <= S x E0 (A2 tolerance).  (1) the scale sweep is the records' own rescore field.

usage: sla_transfer_spec.py RECORDS.jsonl OUT.json

variants.scale_sweep: records' rescore field at (I, S) x {0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3}
variants.itl_only: completed and mean ITL <= I (ITL skipped when output_length <= 1)
variants.e2e_only: completed and e2e <= S x E0 x (1 + 1e-6)
variants.ttft_len_itl: completed and ttft <= b_f + a_f x ISL and mean ITL <= I
variants.abs_e2e_itl: completed and e2e <= abs_e2e_ms_f and mean ITL <= I

window: every variant counts good requests over exactly the record's in-window set (learned_routing.window_guards.in_window_flags rule) divided by the record's window length, like goodput_rps_window
